web_bottleneck: Novanta own bottleneck is manufacturing complexity and asset intensity: two sites closed in Q2 2026, two more by end Q1 2027, plus two MRP implementations (2026-08-05 call). It relieves the OEM need for safe, low-energy humanoid motion and higher-throughput precision manufacturing. Component and rare-earth tightness drove safety stock.
web_who_benefits_next: Humanoid and robotics OEMs; NVIDIA, named as a partner on safe humanoid operations (2026-08-05 call); the AI GPU probe-card and advanced-packaging supply chain; minimally invasive surgery OEMs; insufflation and arthroscopy customers. Second order: contract manufacturers and laser subsystem integrators.
web_who_loses: Competing motion-control, encoder and servo suppliers where Novanta gets designed in, plus OEM in-house motion stacks; rival insufflator and surgical consumable vendors; life-science tool makers facing commoditized pricing that Novanta itself flagged on the 2026-08-05 call.

web_did_they_deliver: Yes on prior promises. 2026-08-05: Q2 revenue $265.8M and adjusted EPS $0.89 beat consensus of $262.3M and $0.83 (TheFly via TipRanks); organic growth of 9.3 percent was the strongest since Q1 2023; Riverpoint closed 2026-07-27 as flagged and two factory closures were completed in Q2.
